# `oaap app migrate-instance-keys`

internal: retire keys, principals and authorization records of instances that no longer exist (RFC-0062 D4).

Internal: called by the platform itself (update, install, the portal or a timer). Not meant to be typed by hand.

**Root:** needs `sudo`.

## Usage

```sh
oaap app migrate-instance-keys
```
